s1.syndrome_frame: Right upper abdominal pain with mass and abnormal liver function
salient_findings: Heterogeneous echoic mass near the gallbladder fossa
key_facts: 2-month history of right upper abdominal pain
No nausea, vomiting, chills, or fever
Right upper abdominal tenderness without rebound or palpable masses
Negative Murphy’s sign and shifting dullness
Ultrasonography showed heterogeneous echoic mass near the gallbladder fossa
Contrast-enhanced CT showed lesion in the right hepatic lobe and multiple enlarged hepatic hilar lymph nodes

raw.syndrome_frame: Right upper abdominal pain with mass and abnormal liver function
salient_findings: Heterogeneous echoic mass near the gallbladder fossa
key_facts: 2-month history of right upper abdominal pain
No nausea, vomiting, chills, or fever
Right upper abdominal tenderness without rebound or palpable masses
Negative Murphy’s sign and shifting dullness
Ultrasonography showed heterogeneous echoic mass near the gallbladder fossa
Contrast-enhanced CT showed lesion in the right hepatic lobe and multiple enlarged hepatic hilar lymph nodes

differentials: Intraductal papillary neoplasm of the bile duct
per_call: Intraductal papillary neoplasm of the bile duct

shortlist.label: Intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated CA19-9 and imaging findings of a heterogeneous echoic mass near the gallbladder fossa

shortlist.label: Gallbladder cancer
shortlist.why_kept: Gallbladder wall thickening and calcifications in the right liver, along with gallstones

shortlist.label: Hepatocellular carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated AFP and a lesion in the right hepatic lobe adjacent to the gallbladder fossa

shortlist.label: Cholangiocarcinoma of the gallbladder
shortlist.why_kept: Imaging findings of a lesion in the right hepatic lobe and multiple enlarged hepatic hilar lymph nodes

shortlist.label: Klatskin tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Imaging findings of a lesion in the right hepatic lobe and multiple enlarged hepatic hilar lymph nodes, with elevated CA19-9

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of right upper abdominal pain, elevated CA19-9 level, and imaging findings of a heterogeneous echoic mass near the gallbladder fossa and intrahepatic bile duct dilatation are consistent with intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma.

rejected.label: Gallbladder cancer
rejected.why: While gallstones and gallbladder wall thickening are present, the primary lesion is in the liver, not the gallbladder.

rejected.label: Hepatocellular carcinoma
rejected.why: The patient's AFP level is within normal limits, and the tumor markers and imaging findings are more suggestive of cholangiocarcinoma.

rejected.label: Cholangiocarcinoma of the gallbladder
rejected.why: The primary lesion is in the liver, not the gallbladder, making this diagnosis less likely.

rejected.label: Klatskin tumor
rejected.why: A Klatskin tumor is a type of cholangiocarcinoma that occurs at the junction of the right and left hepatic ducts, but the patient's imaging findings do not specifically suggest this location.
